diagnostics.note: MAX-SAT re-run from constraint_cache yields 55.9% vs original 59.3% due to z3 dedup order sensitivity (15/204 differ). All method comparisons are on same re-deduped constraint set.
diagnostics.min_unsat_failure_reason: Most problems have 0-2 excluded constraints (mean=1.3). With so few exclusions, MIN-UNSAT has near-zero discriminative signal. In 65/204 cases all candidates tie at 0, falling back to SC.

conclusion: MIN-UNSAT hypothesis REJECTED. MIN-UNSAT scoring degrades accuracy by ~6-7pp vs MAX-SAT because the MAX-SAT solver only excludes 1.3 constraints per problem on average (80/204 have zero). With so little exclusion signal, MIN-UNSAT either ties all candidates (falling back to SC) or makes worse selections. Removing trivially satisfied constraints (only 4.8%, not 43%) has zero impact.
